## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands and browser checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request has one clear purpose.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests where practical.
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented.
- [ ] I checked visual changes in a browser.
- [ ] I preserved the sandbox and HTML parser invariants.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, generated output, or unrelated changes.
